app_tagline: Calories, weight and water, on your own server.
placeholder_building: The first screens are being built.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error_cancelled: The passkey prompt was closed. Try again when you're ready.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
error_not_verified: That passkey couldn't be verified. Please try again.
error_unknown_credential: This passkey isn't registered here. Use another passkey or a recovery code.
field_display_name_hint: Shown to people in your household.
field_passkey_label_hint: For example iPhone or YubiKey, so you can tell them apart later.
login_body: Use the passkey on this device or a security key.
setup_body: You're creating the first account. It will be the household's admin.
setup_unavailable: This setup link has expired or has already been used. Ask the server operator for a new one.
setup_missing: Open the full setup link from the server. It includes a code after the # sign.
join_body: You've been invited. Choose a name and create a passkey to sign in with.
join_unavailable: This invite has expired, was cancelled or has already been used. Ask for a new one.
join_missing: Open the full invite link. It includes a code after the # sign.
codes_body: If you lose every passkey, one of these codes lets you back in. Each works once. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager.
recover_body: Enter one of your recovery codes. You'll then create a new passkey.
recover_link_body: This recovery link was issued by your household's admin.
recover_invalid: That code or link isn't valid, has expired or was already used.
recover_warning: Creating a new passkey signs you out everywhere, removes all your old passkeys and replaces your recovery codes.
recover_expired: Recovery took too long. Start again with another code.
reauth_body: For this change, confirm with a passkey.
security_add: Add a passkey or security key
security_add_hint: A second passkey, such as a YubiKey, lets you sign in if you lose this phone.
security_remove_confirm: Remove the passkey "{label}"? You won't be able to sign in with it.
security_last_credential: You can't remove your only passkey. Add another one first.
security_codes_new_confirm: Create new recovery codes? Your old codes will stop working.
household_invite_ready: Send this link privately. It works once and expires in 7 days.
foods_search_placeholder: Name or brand, e.g. sutas ayran
foods_none: No foods match. Create one with New food.
food_serving_size_hint: Only if the label states it. Lets you log this food in grams or ml.
food_values_hint: Leave a value empty if the label doesn't show it: empty means unknown, not zero. Tick < when the label gives a value as less than, such as <0,5 g.
food_portions_hint: Named amounts you log often, such as a slice (26 g) or a can (330 ml).
food_conflict: Someone changed this food while you were editing. Reload to see their version.
food_energy_required: Enter the energy (kcal or kJ) from the label.
food_variant_hint: Creates a private copy you can change without affecting the shared food.
food_archived: Archived. It no longer appears in search; past diary entries are unaffected.
food_read_only: Shared by someone in your household. You can log it or make your own variant.
food_from_variant: Your variant of a shared food.
food_source_usda: Values per 100 g from USDA FoodData Central ({dataset}, public domain). Carbohydrate there includes fibre; the figure without fibre is an estimate.
warning_sugars_exceed_carbohydrate: Sugars are higher than carbohydrate. Check both values.
warning_saturated_exceeds_fat: Saturated fat is higher than total fat. Check both values.
warning_mass_exceeds_100: These values add up to more than 100 g per 100 g. A value may be misread.
warning_energy_units_mismatch: kJ and kcal don't match. Check both energy values.
warning_energy_macros_mismatch: Energy doesn't match the fat, carbohydrate and protein. Labels round, but check the values.
warning_salt_sodium_mismatch: Salt and sodium don't match. Check both values.
log_no_recent: Foods you log will appear here.
amount_late_night: It's after midnight. Did you mean yesterday?
amount_conversion_unknown: This food has no weight or volume for that unit. Choose another unit or add a portion to the food.
amount_carbs_unstated: Carbs: the source did not state whether fibre is included.
quick_description_placeholder: e.g. simit, dinner at a friend's
quick_note: Only the calories are recorded. Other nutrients stay unknown.
toast_conflict: This entry changed on another device. Showing the latest version.
water_other_invalid: Enter an amount up to 10 l, such as 750 ml or 3,5 l.
readings_changed: This changed on another device. Close and reopen to see the latest.
entry_food_none: No food found for “{text}”. Remove it, or add the food first.
entry_nothing: Nothing to log in that. Try “200 g chicken for lunch” or “iki bardak su”.
entry_partial: Some items could not be saved. They are still here to try again.
speak_example: “Öğle yemeğinde 150 gram tavuk göğsü ve iki dilim ekmek yedim” · “two slices of bread for breakfast”
speak_mic_blocked: The microphone is blocked for this site. Allow it in your browser’s settings, or type instead.
speak_mic_missing: No microphone was found on this device.
speak_nothing_heard: Nothing was heard. Try again a little closer to the phone.
speak_too_long: That was too long. Keep it under 30 seconds.
speak_busy: The speech service is busy. Try again in a moment.
speak_unavailable: The speech service can’t be reached right now. Try again, or type instead.
speak_limited: That’s a lot of recordings in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
saved_toast_detail: Find it in Log under Saved meals.
saved_refresh_hint: Saved items keep the values they had when saved. Updating uses each food's current values; entries you already logged don't change.
saved_delete_hint: Entries you logged from it stay in your diary.
saved_none: No saved meals yet. Create one with New meal, or use the bookmark on a meal on Today.
recipes_none: No recipes yet. A recipe adds up its ingredients and divides by the servings it makes; log it like any food.
recipe_yield_hint: Weigh the finished dish to log it in grams too. Without it, log it by servings.
recipe_energy_unknown: Energy is unknown because an ingredient doesn't state it. Unknown values are never counted as zero.
recipe_invalid: Check the servings (more than 0, up to 1000) and the cooked weight.
recipe_no_nesting: A recipe can't be an ingredient of another recipe yet.
recipe_refresh_hint: Ingredients keep the values they had when added. Updating uses each food's current values; entries you already logged don't change.
recipe_archive_hint: Archived recipes stay in your diary history but no longer appear in search.
recipe_shared_hint: Others in the household see a shared recipe as a food with its totals, never its ingredients.
recipe_yours: This is one of your recipes; its values come from its ingredients.
recipe_from_others: A recipe: values per serving, from its ingredients.
meal_editor_save_first: Save or cancel your changes first.
meal_editor_changed: This meal changed on another device. Cancel and open it again to see the latest.
saved_changed: This saved meal changed on another device. Close and reopen it to see the latest.
budget_activity_not_added: {kcal} kcal burned, not added (your budget setting).
budget_floor: Raised to your minimum of {floor} kcal.
activity_meaning: One activity on its own, such as a walk or a gym session: enter only the extra calories above an ordinary inactive day. Each one adds to the day's budget.
activity_total_meaning: The active calories a watch, phone or fitness app has counted for the whole day so far (on Apple Watch, the Move ring), not its total calories, which include what you burn at rest. Enter it again later: the newest day total replaces the earlier one instead of adding to it. Don't also add activities it already counted.
day_complete_hint: Only complete days count as under budget in your calendar.
onb_intro: A few details let obur estimate how much energy you use on a quiet day. You can skip this and set a number yourself.
onb_sex_hint: The energy formulas differ for female and male bodies.
onb_bmi_note: BMI compares weight with height. It can't tell muscle from fat, so treat it as a rough guide, not a diagnosis.
onb_bmi_no_category: Adult BMI categories don't apply here.
onb_whtr_note: A ratio under 0.5 is often used as a guide.
onb_base_note: What your body uses on a day without exercise ({formula}, × 1.2). You can set your own number instead.
onb_fixed_base: Use my own base burn (kcal, optional)
onb_rate_capped: Faster paces are limited to 1 % of your body weight per week.
onb_budget_detail: {base} base − {deficit} for your goal, plus any activity you add each day.
onb_disclaimer: These targets are estimates, not medical advice.
onb_manual_body: If you already know your daily target, or a professional gave you one, enter it here.
onb_restricted: obur doesn't calculate targets during pregnancy, while breastfeeding or for under-18s. You can still log everything, and enter a target from your doctor or dietitian below.
details_weight_hint: A new number is saved as today's weigh-in.
details_budget_follows: Your calculated budget follows these from today on. Past days keep their budgets.
details_budget_kept: Your budget stays as it is.
details_invalid: Check the highlighted values: height 50–260 cm, a past birth date, a sex, and weights 20–700 kg.
details_not_recalculated: Your budget wasn't recalculated: obur doesn't calculate one for these details. Set your own number with Recalculate.
profile_settings_activity: Add calories I burn to my budget
profile_settings_activity_hint: Activities and day totals you enter. When off, they are kept but don't change your budget.
profile_settings_goal: When I reach my goal weight
macros_balanced_hint: Protein from your body weight (1,2 g per kg), fat 30 % of your budget, carbs the rest. They follow your budget.
macros_none_hint: A budget you set yourself has no macro targets unless you choose your own percentages.
macros_total_ok: Adds up to 100 % of {kcal} kcal. The grams follow your budget each day.
profile_settings_saved_detail: They apply from today; earlier days keep their budgets.
profile_follows_weight: Updates from the day you log a new weight. Past days keep their budgets.
progress_summary: Under {under} · Over {over} · Not complete {incomplete} · Not logged {unlogged}
progress_summary_note: Today isn't counted until it's over.
progress_weight_none: No weigh-ins in the last 90 days.
progress_weight_chart: Weight over the last 90 days: from {first} kg to {last} kg
offline_cached_copy: Showing the copy saved on this device. It will update when the server can be reached.
offline_saved_detail: It will be sent when you're back online.
offline_signin: Sign in again to send {count} waiting entries.
offline_review: Couldn't be saved. The food may have changed while you were offline.
offline_discard_body: This entry is only on this device and hasn't reached the server yet.
signout_pending: {count} entries on this device haven't been sent yet. Signing out will discard them. Sign out anyway?
data_export_body: A ZIP file with everything you've logged, your foods, targets and profile, as JSON with CSV copies for spreadsheets. Passkeys, sessions and other people's data are not included.
data_import_body: Bring in an export from obur (this server or another one) or from LoseIt. You'll see what would change before anything is saved. Imported foods are private unless you choose to share them.
data_warn_already_imported: This file has already been imported.
data_warn_changed_kept: Some records differ from the ones already here. The current versions are kept.
data_warn_targets_kept: You already have targets, so the imported ones are not added. Past days keep your current budgets.
data_warn_food_links_dropped: Some entries refer to foods that aren't in the file. They keep their own nutrition.
data_error_archive: This file can't be imported. It isn't a complete, unchanged obur export.
data_error_too_large: This file is too large to import.
data_error_version: This export comes from a newer version of obur.
data_delete_body: Deletes your diary, weight, water, activity, targets, profile, private foods, passkeys and recovery codes from this server. Export first if you want a copy.
data_delete_backups: Deleted data can remain in encrypted backups until those expire. Backups are not a way to undo this.
data_delete_shared: Foods you shared with the household
data_delete_shared_note: Other people's diary entries keep their own nutrition either way.
data_delete_confirm_check: I understand this can't be undone
data_delete_last_admin: You're this household's only admin, so this account can't be deleted here.
household_delete_body: Deletes their diary, body data, targets, profile, private foods and passkeys. This can't be undone.
household_deletions_body: Keep a copy of this list off the server with the backup key. After a restore from backup, these accounts must be deleted again.
backup_not_configured: Backups aren't set up on this installation.
backup_no_status: No backup status yet. The database may still be starting.
backup_backup_stale: The last backup is more than a day and a half old.
backup_offsite_failed: The last backup could not be copied off-site.
backup_archive_failing: Recent changes are not being archived. Backups between nightly runs are incomplete.
backup_restore_check_failed: The last restore check failed. The backups may not be restorable.
backup_restore_check_stale: No restore check has passed in the last week.
backup_offsite_restore_failed: The last restore check from the off-site copy failed. That copy may not be restorable.
backup_offsite_restore_stale: No restore from the off-site copy has passed in the last week.
backup_no_offsite: There is no off-site copy. If this server's disks fail or the server is lost, the backups go with it.
restore_in_progress: obur is being restored from a backup. Please try again in a little while.
log_search_offline: Search needs a connection. You can still quick add calories, or pick a recent food.
offline_page_body: This page isn't saved on this device yet. It will open once you're back online.
data_import_loseit_check_ok: All {days} days add up to LoseIt's own daily totals.
data_import_loseit_check_bad: {count} days don't add up to LoseIt's own daily totals: {dates}.
data_import_loseit_deleted: Entries you deleted in LoseIt are left out ({count}).
data_import_weight_unit: Weights in this export are in
data_import_share: Share my custom foods with the household
data_import_missing: Move {count} entries to the trash: they were imported before but aren't in this export (deleted or changed in LoseIt).
data_import_activity_note: Activity from LoseIt is recorded but doesn't change your budget.
data_warn_budgets_after_own_target: LoseIt budgets from the day you set a target in obur are left out; obur's target applies from then on.
data_warn_height_out_of_range: The height in this export isn't in centimetres, so it's left out of your profile.
data_warn_reconciliation_mismatch: Some days don't add up to LoseIt's totals. Check them after importing.
data_error_loseit_layout: This LoseIt export has a layout obur doesn't recognise, so nothing was imported.
data_error_loseit_value: This LoseIt export has a value obur can't read: {detail}.
nutrients_carbs_plus_unstated: + {value} g with the definition not stated (imported)
